\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage{dirtreex}
\newlength\ProbeLength
\def\ProbeColor{red}
\def\ProbeName{\textbf{ordinary}}
\def\ProbeComment{\textit{kept token}}
\makeatletter
\begingroup
  \def\PackageError#1#2#3{\typeout{PROBE EXPECTED: #2}}
  \dte@parsefour{1pt,2pt}\ProbeA\ProbeB\ProbeC\ProbeD
  \setlength{\ProbeLength}{\ProbeA}
  \typeout{PROBE FOUR-RECOVERY: \the\ProbeLength}
  \dte@parsetwo{1pt,2pt,3pt}\ProbeA\ProbeB
  \setlength{\ProbeLength}{\ProbeA}
  \typeout{PROBE TWO-RECOVERY: \the\ProbeLength}
\endgroup
\let\ProbeOriginalPreprocess\dte@preprocess
\def\dte@preprocess{%
  \typeout{PROBE COUNT: \the\dte@cnt}%
  \typeout{PROBE ENV-COLOR-MEANING: \meaning\dte@linecolor}%
  \typeout{PROBE ENV-WIDTH: \the\dte@rulewidth}%
  \dte@i=1\relax
  \loop\ifnum\dte@i<\numexpr\dte@cnt+1\relax
    \typeout{PROBE ENTRY: \the\dte@i, DEPTH \dte@eget{\the\dte@i}{d}, TYPE \dte@eget{\the\dte@i}{t}}%
    \typeout{PROBE NAME: \expandafter\meaning\csname dte@e\the\dte@i n\endcsname}%
    \typeout{PROBE COMMENT: \expandafter\meaning\csname dte@e\the\dte@i c\endcsname}%
    \typeout{PROBE COLOR: \expandafter\meaning\csname dte@e\the\dte@i lc\endcsname}%
    \typeout{PROBE WIDTH: \expandafter\meaning\csname dte@e\the\dte@i lw\endcsname}%
    \typeout{PROBE ICON: \expandafter\meaning\csname dte@e\the\dte@i i\endcsname}%
    \advance\dte@i by1\relax
  \repeat
  \ProbeOriginalPreprocess
}
\let\ProbeOriginalFormatter\DirtreexFormatName
\renewcommand\DirtreexFormatName[1]{%
  \ifnum#1=3\relax
    \typeout{PROBE ENTRY-WIDTH-AT-RENDER: \the\dimexpr\dte@eget{3}{lw}\relax}%
  \fi
  \ProbeOriginalFormatter{#1}%
}
\makeatother
\begin{document}
\begin{dirtreex}[line color=\ProbeColor,line width=1em,fontsize=\footnotesize,pagebreak=false]
  \verbdir|root_%$#&^~\{}|{root}{
    \dir{\ProbeName}{\ProbeComment}

    {
      \file[line color=\ProbeColor,line width=1em,icon={\textcolor{blue}{[F]}}]{plain.txt}{\ProbeComment}
    }
    \archive{archive.zip}{}{\verbfile|a_b%$#&^~\{}|{verbatim}}
    \verbarchive|v_%$#.zip|{}{\file{last.txt}{}}
    \verbfile|final name.txt|{final}
  }
  \gdef\ProbeColor{blue}
\end{dirtreex}
\end{document}
